title: K-flat representative transpose for exact-right derived adjunctions
statement: Let C be a Grothendieck abelian closed braided monoidal category with additive tensor, functorial flat resolutions and exact integer-indexed colimits [def-sp-grothendieck-abelian, def-sfb-monoidal-category, lem-pc-source-module-kflat-resolution]. Let D be abelian, and choose derived localizations of C and D independently [def-weil-abstract-derived-category]. Let E:C→D and U:D→C be additive with E⊣U, U exact and E preserving quasi-isomorphisms between K-flat complexes [def-sfb-preserves-kflat-quasi-iso]. For any chosen adjunction L⊣D(U) and K-flat complex X, the transpose under this chosen adjunction of the localized ordinary unit Q(X)→Q(U(E(X)))≅D(U)(Q(E(X))) is an isomorphism L(Q(X))→Q(E(X)).

source.place: Tag 06YY; cochain calculation using Mathlib derived adjunctions and absolute K-flat left derivability. Unlike the existing cochain-counit interface, localization and category universes remain independent.

proof.text: The K-flat derivability structure gives the total left derived functor of E and makes its counit invertible on K-flat complexes. This derivation is absolute. Exactness of U gives an invertible factorization of its homotopy functor, hence a right derived functor, also after postcomposition.

Apply Mathlib Adjunction.derived to the termwise homotopy adjunction. Its unit equation, together with the quotient-comparison isomorphisms, expresses the transpose as the left-derived counit conjugated by quotient isomorphisms and the unique unit-preserving comparison with the chosen left adjoint. All four factors are invertible on a K-flat X.

theorem Adjunction.isIso_cochainTranspose_of_kFlat
    {L : DerivedCategory C ⥤ DerivedCategory D}
    (adj : E ⊣ U) (ad : L ⊣ U.mapDerivedCategory) (X : CochainComplex C ℤ)
    (hX : (HomologicalComplex.quasiIso C (.up ℤ)).kFlat X) :
    IsIso ((ad.homEquiv _ _).symm
      (DerivedCategory.Q.map ((adj.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).unit.app X) ≫
        U.mapDerivedCategoryFactors.inv.app ((E.mapHomologicalComplex (.up ℤ)).obj X)))
